message.name: FIToFICustomerCreditTransferV14
message.definition:
Scope
The FinancialInstitutionToFinancialInstitutionCustomerCreditTransfer message is sent by the debtor agent to the creditor agent, directly or through other agents and/or a payment clearing and settlement system. It is used to move funds from a debtor account to a creditor.
Usage
The FIToFICustomerCreditTransfer message is exchanged between agents and can contain one or more customer credit transfer instructions.
The FIToFICustomerCreditTransfer message does not allow for grouping: a CreditTransferTransactionInformation block must be present for each credit transfer transaction.
The FIToFICustomerCreditTransfer message can be used in different ways:
- If the instructing agent and the instructed agent wish to use their direct account relationship in the currency of the transfer then the message contains both the funds for the customer transfer(s) as well as the payment details;
- If the instructing agent and the instructed agent have no direct account relationship in the currency of the transfer, or do not wish to use their account relationship, then other (reimbursement) agents will be involved to cover for the customer transfer(s). The FIToFICustomerCreditTransfer contains only the payment details and the instructing agent must cover the customer transfer by sending a FinancialInstitutionCreditTransfer to a reimbursement agent. This payment method is called the Cover method;
- If more than two financial institutions are involved in the payment chain and if the FIToFICustomerCreditTransfer is sent from one financial institution to the next financial institution in the payment chain, then the payment method is called the Serial method.
The FIToFICustomerCreditTransfer message can be used in domestic and cross-border scenarios.

IBAN2007Identifier.definition: The International Bank Account Number is a code used internationally by financial institutions to uniquely identify the account of a customer at a financial institution as described in the 2007 edition of the ISO 13616 standard "Banking and related financial services - International Bank Account Number (IBAN)" and replaced by the more recent edition of the standard.

ISODate.definition: A particular point in the progression of time in a calendar year expressed in the YYYY-MM-DD format. This representation is defined in "XML Schema Part 2: Datatypes Second Edition - W3C Recommendation 28 October 2004" which is aligned with ISO 8601.

ISODateTime.definition:
A particular point in the progression of time defined by a mandatory date and a mandatory time component, expressed in either UTC time format (YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss.sssZ), local time with UTC offset format (YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss.sss+/-hh:mm), or local time format (YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss.sss). These representations are defined in "XML Schema Part 2: Datatypes Second Edition - W3C Recommendation 28 October 2004" which is aligned with ISO 8601.
Note on the time format:
1) beginning / end of calendar day
00:00:00 = the beginning of a calendar day
24:00:00 = the end of a calendar day
2) fractions of second in time format
Decimal fractions of seconds may be included. In this case, the involved parties shall agree on the maximum number of digits that are allowed.

ISOTime.definition:
A particular point in the progression of time in a calendar day expressed in either UTC time format (hh:mm:ss.sssZ), local time with UTC offset format (hh:mm:ss.sss+/-hh:mm), or local time format (hh:mm:ss.sss). These representations are defined in "XML Schema Part 2: Datatypes Second Edition - W3C Recommendation 28 October 2004" which is aligned with ISO 8601.
Note on the time format:
1) beginning / end of calendar day
00:00:00 = the beginning of a calendar day
24:00:00 = the end of a calendar day
2) fractions of second in time format
Decimal fractions of seconds may be included. In this case, the involved parties shall agree on the maximum number of digits that are allowed.

CCPM.definition: Cash Collateral associated with an ISDA or Central Clearing Agreement that is covering the variation margin requirements for OTC trades clearing through a CCP.

CCRD.name: CreditCardPayment
CCRD.definition: Transaction is related to a payment of credit card account.

CCSM.name: CCPClearedInitialMarginSegregatedCash
CCSM.definition: CCP Segregated initial margin: Initial margin on OTC Derivatives cleared through a CCP that requires segregation.

CDBL.name: CreditCardBill
CDBL.definition: Transaction is related to a payment of credit card bill.

CDCB.name: CardPaymentWithCashBack
CDCB.definition: Purchase of Goods and Services with additional Cash disbursement at the POI (Cashback).

CDCD.name: CashDisbursementCashSettlement
CDCD.definition: ATM Cash Withdrawal in an unattended or Cash Advance in an attended environment (POI or bank counter).

CDCS.name: CashDisbursementWithSurcharging
CDCS.definition: ATM Cash Withdrawal in an unattended or Cash Advance in an attended environment (POI or bank counter) with surcharging.

CDDP.name: CardDeferredPayment
CDDP.definition: A combined service which enables the card acceptor to perform an authorisation for a temporary amount and a completion for the final amount within a limited time frame. Deferred Payment is only available in the unattended environment. Examples where this service is widely used are unattended petrol pumps and phone booths.

CDEP.name: CreditDefaultEventPayment
CDEP.definition: Payment related to a credit default event.

CDOC.name: OriginalCredit
CDOC.definition: A service which allows the card acceptor to effect a credit to a cardholder' account. Unlike a Merchant Refund, an Original Credit is not preceded by a card payment. This service is used for example for crediting winnings from gaming.

CDQC.name: QuasiCash
CDQC.definition: Purchase of Goods which are equivalent to cash like coupons in casinos.

CFDI.name: CapitalFallingDueInhouse
CFDI.definition: Transaction is the payment of capital falling due where custodian bank and current account servicing bank coincide.

CFEE.name: CancellationFee
CFEE.definition: Transaction is related to a payment of cancellation fee.

CGDD.name: CardGeneratedDirectDebit
CGDD.definition: Transaction is related to a direct debit where the mandate was generated by using data from a payment card at the point of sale.

CHAR.name: CharityPayment
CHAR.definition: Transaction is a payment for charity reasons.

CHCP.name: CharitableDonationCorporate
CHCP.definition: Charitable donation being processed on behalf of a Corporate entity.

CHDF.name: CharitableDonationDAF
CHDF.definition: Charitable donation being processed on behalf of a Donor Advised Fund (DAF).

CHFN.name: CharitableDonationFoundation
CHFN.definition: Charitable donation being processed on behalf of a Foundation (purpose-driven entity).

CLDS.name: ConstructionLoanDisbursement
CLDS.definition: Construction Loan Disbursement, e.g., phased disbursements for construction projects based on completion milestones.

CLPR.name: CarLoanPrincipalRepayment
CLPR.definition: Transaction is a payment of car loan principal payment.

COLL.name: CollectionPayment
COLL.definition: Transaction is a collection of funds initiated via a credit transfer or direct debit.

COMC.name: CommercialPayment
COMC.definition: Transaction is related to a payment of commercial credit or debit. (formerly CommercialCredit).

COMP.name: CompensationPayment
COMP.definition: Transaction is related to the payment of a compensation relating to interest loss/value date adjustment and can include fees.

COMT.name: ConsumerThirdPartyConsolidatedPayment
COMT.definition: Transaction is a payment used by a third party who can collect funds to pay on behalf of consumers, ie credit counseling or bill payment companies.

CORT.name: TradeSettlementPayment
CORT.definition: Transaction is related to settlement of a trade, e.g. a foreign exchange deal or a securities transaction.

COST.name: Costs
COST.definition: Transaction is related to payment of costs.

CPEN.name: CashPenalties
CPEN.definition: Cash penalties related to securities transaction, including CSDR Settlement Discipline Regime.

CPKC.name: CarparkCharges
CPKC.definition: Transaction is related to carpark charges.

CRDS.name: CreditDefaultSwap
CRDS.definition: Cash collateral related to trading of credit default swap.

CRPR.name: CrossProduct
CRPR.definition: Cash collateral related to a combination of various types of trades.

CRSP.name: CreditSupport
CRSP.definition: Cash collateral related to cash lending/borrowing; letter of Credit; signing of master agreement.

CRTL.name: CreditLine
CRTL.definition: Cash collateral related to opening of a credit line before trading.

CRYP.name: CryptoAssets
CRYP.definition: Transaction is related to the purchase or sale of crypto assets.

CSDB.name: CashDisbursementCashManagement
CSDB.definition: Transaction is related to cash disbursement.

CSLP.name: CompanySocialLoanPaymentToBank
CSLP.definition: Transaction is a payment by a company to a bank for financing social loans to employees.

CVCF.name: ConvalescentCareFacility
CVCF.definition: Transaction is a payment for convalescence care facility services.

DBCR.name: DebitCard
DBCR.definition: Card Settlement-Settlement of Debit Card transactions.

DBTC.name: DebitCollectionPayment
DBTC.definition: Collection of funds initiated via a debit transfer.

DCRD.name: DebitCardPayment
DCRD.definition: Transaction is related to a debit card payment.

DEBT.name: ChargesBorneByDebtor
DEBT.definition: Purpose of payment is the settlement of charges payable by the debtor in relation to an underlying customer credit transfer.

DEPD.name: DependentSupportPayment
DEPD.definition: Transaction is related to a payment concerning dependent support, for example child support or support for a person substantially financially dependent on the support provider.

DEPT.name: Deposit
DEPT.definition: Transaction is releted to a payment of deposit.

DERI.name: Derivatives
DERI.definition: Transaction is related to a derivatives transaction.

DMEQ.name: DurableMedicaleEquipment
DMEQ.definition: Transaction is a payment is for use of durable medical equipment.

DNTS.name: DentalServices
DNTS.definition: Transaction is a payment for dental services.

DSMT.name: PrintedOrderDisbursement
DSMT.definition: Transaction is the payment of a disbursement due to a specific type of printed order for a payment of a  specified sum, issued by a bank or a post office (Zahlungsanweisung zur Verrechnung)

DVPM.name: DeliverAgainstPayment
DVPM.definition: Code used to pre-advise the account servicer of a forthcoming deliver against payment instruction.

ECPG.name: GuaranteedEPayment
ECPG.definition: E-Commerce payment with payment guarantee of the issuing bank.

ECPU.name: NonGuaranteedEPayment
ECPU.definition: E-Commerce payment without payment guarantee of the issuing bank.

EDUC.name: Education
EDUC.definition: Transaction is related to a payment of study/tuition fees.

EFTC.name: LowValueCredit
EFTC.definition: Utilities-Settlement of Low value Credit transactions.

EFTD.name: LowValueDebit
EFTD.definition: Utilities-Settlement of Low value Debit transactions.

ELEC.name: ElectricityBill
ELEC.definition: Transaction is related to a payment of electricity bill.

ENRG.name: Energies
ENRG.definition: Transaction is related to a utility operation.

EQPT.name: EquityOption
EQPT.definition: Cash collateral related to trading of equity option (Also known as stock options).

EQUS.name: EquitySwap
EQUS.definition: Cash collateral related to equity swap trades where the return of an equity is exchanged for either a fixed or a floating rate of interest.

ERPM.name: EmergencyReliefPayment
ERPM.definition: Emergency relief payments, e.g., receiving assistance after natural disasters, COVID relief payments, or emergency aid disbursements.

ESCR.name: EscrowPayment
ESCR.definition: Financial intermediation services via an escrow account, e.g., real estate transactions, online marketplace purchases, business acquisitions, construction projects, legal settlements.

ESTX.name: EstateTax
ESTX.definition: Transaction is related to a payment of estate tax.

ETUP.name: EPurseTopUp
ETUP.definition: Transaction is related to a Service that is first reserving money from a card account and then is loading an e-purse application by this amount.

EXPT.name: ExoticOption
EXPT.definition: Cash collateral related to trading of an exotic option for example a non-standard option.

EXTD.name: ExchangeTradedDerivatives
EXTD.definition: Cash collateral related to trading of exchanged traded derivatives in general (Opposite to Over the Counter (OTC)).

FACT.name: FactorUpdateRelatedPayment
FACT.definition: Payment related to a factor update

FAND.name: FinancialAidInCaseOfNaturalDisaster
FAND.definition: Financial aid by State authorities for abolition of consequences of natural disasters.

FCOL.name: FeeCollection
FCOL.definition: A Service that is settling card transaction related fees between two parties.

FCPM.name: LatePaymentOfFeesAndCharges
FCPM.definition: Transaction is the payment for late fees & charges. E.g Credit card charges

FERB.name: Ferry
FERB.definition: Transaction is a payment for ferry related business.

FGDL.name: FoodGroceryDelivery
FGDL.definition: Food/Grocery Delivery, e.g., delivery fees and payments through app-based food delivery services.

FIXI.name: FixedIncome
FIXI.definition: Cash collateral related to a fixed income instrument

FNET.name: FuturesNettingPayment
FNET.definition: Cash associated with a netting of futures payments. Refer to CCPM codeword for netting of initial and variation margin through a CCP

FORW.name: ForwardForeignExchange
FORW.definition: FX trades with a value date in the future.

FREX.name: ForeignExchange
FREX.definition: Transaction is related to a foreign exchange operation.

FUEL.name: Fuel
FUEL.definition: Fuel/Gas, e.g., purchases at gas stations for vehicle fuel or at charging stations for electric vehicles.

FUTR.name: Futures
FUTR.definition: Cash related to futures trading activity.

FWBC.name: ForwardBrokerOwnedCashCollateral
FWBC.definition: Cash collateral payment against a Master Forward Agreement (MFA) where the cash is held in a segregated account and is not available for use by the client. Includes any instruments with a forward settling date such TBAs, repurchase agreements and bond forwards

FWCC.name: ForwardClientOwnedCashCollateral
FWCC.definition: Cash collateral payment against a Master Forward Agreement (MFA) where the cash is owned and may be used by the client when returned. Includes any instruments with a forward settling date such TBAs, repurchase agreements and bond forwards

FWLV.name: ForeignWorkerLevy
FWLV.definition: Transaction is related to a payment of Foreign Worker Levy

FWSB.name: ForwardBrokerOwnedCashCollateralSegregated
FWSB.definition: Any cash payment related to the collateral for a Master Agreement forward, which is segregated, and not available for use by the client. Example master agreement forwards include TBA, repo and Bond Forwards.

FWSC.name: ForwardClientOwnedSegregatedCashCollateral
FWSC.definition: Any cash payment related to the collateral for a Master agreement forward, which is owned by the client and is available for use by the client when it is returned to them from the segregated account. Example master agreement forwards include TBA, repo and Bond Forwards.

FXNT.name: ForeignExchangeRelatedNetting
FXNT.definition: FX netting if cash is moved by separate wire instead of within the closing FX instruction

GAFA.name: GovernmentFamilyAllowance
GAFA.definition: Salary and Benefits-Allowance from government to support family.

GAHO.name: GovernmentHousingAllowance
GAHO.definition: Salary and Benefits-Allowance from government to individuals to support payments of housing.

GAMB.name: GamblingOrWageringPayment
GAMB.definition: General-Payments towards a purchase or winnings received from gambling, betting or other wagering activities.

GASB.name: GasBill
GASB.definition: Transaction is related to a payment of gas bill.

GDDS.name: PurchaseSaleOfGoods
GDDS.definition: Transaction is related to purchase and sale of goods.

GDSV.name: PurchaseSaleOfGoodsAndServices
GDSV.definition: Transaction is related to purchase and sale of goods and services.

GFRP.name: GuaranteeFundRightsPayment
GFRP.definition: Compensation to unemployed persons during insolvency procedures.

GIFT.name: Gift
GIFT.definition: Payment with no commercial or statutory purpose.

GOVG.name: GovernmentGrants
GOVG.definition: Government Grants, e.g., receiving funds for academic research, small business development, educational programs, or community initiatives.

GOVI.name: GovernmentInsurance
GOVI.definition: Transaction is related to a payment of government insurance.

GOVT.name: GovernmentPayment
GOVT.definition: Transaction is a payment to or from a government department.

GSCB.name: PurchaseSaleOfGoodsAndServicesWithCashBack
GSCB.definition: Transaction is related to purchase and sale of goods and services with cash back.

GSTX.name: GoodsServicesTax
GSTX.definition: Transaction is the payment of Goods & Services Tax

GVEA.name: AustrianGovernmentEmployeesCategoryA
GVEA.definition: Transaction is payment to category A Austrian government employees.

GVEB.name: AustrianGovernmentEmployeesCategoryB
GVEB.definition: Transaction is payment to category B Austrian government employees.

GVEC.name: AustrianGovernmentEmployeesCategoryC
GVEC.definition: Transaction is payment to category C Austrian government employees.

GVED.name: AustrianGovernmentEmployeesCategoryD
GVED.definition: Transaction is payment to category D Austrian government employees.

GWLT.name: GovermentWarLegislationTransfer
GWLT.definition: Payment to victims of war violence and to disabled soldiers.

GYMM.name: GymMembership
GYMM.definition: Gym Membership, e.g., monthly or annual fees for fitness centers or health clubs.

HEDG.name: Hedging
HEDG.definition: Transaction is related to a hedging operation.

HLRP.name: PropertyLoanRepayment
HLRP.definition: Transaction is related to a payment of property loan.

HLST.name: PropertyLoanSettlement
HLST.definition: Transaction is related to the settlement of a property loan.

HLTC.name: HomeHealthCare
HLTC.definition: Transaction is a payment for home health care services.

HLTI.name: HealthInsurance
HLTI.definition: Transaction is a payment of health insurance.

HMMS.name: HomeMaintenanceServices
HMMS.definition: Home Maintenance Related, e.g., regular services for home cleaning, lawn care, pest control, or pool maintenance.

HREC.name: HousingRelatedContribution
HREC.definition: Transaction is a contribution by an employer to the housing expenditures (purchase, construction, renovation) of the employees within a tax free fringe benefit system.

HRPS.name: HomeRepairServices
HRPS.definition: Home Repair, e.g., one-time or emergency repairs for washer/dryer, damaged floors, plumbing issues, or electrical problems.

HSPC.name: HospitalCare
HSPC.definition: Transaction is a payment for hospital care services.

HSTX.name: HousingTax
HSTX.definition: Transaction is related to a payment of housing tax.

ICCP.name: IrrevocableCreditCardPayment
ICCP.definition: Transaction is reimbursement of credit card payment.

ICRF.name: IntermediateCareFacility
ICRF.definition: Transaction is a payment for intermediate care facility services.

IDCP.name: IrrevocableDebitCardPayment
IDCP.definition: Transaction is reimbursement of debit card payment.

IHRP.name: InstalmentHirePurchaseAgreement
IHRP.definition: Transaction is payment for an installment/hire-purchase agreement.

INBC.name: InterbankCharges
INBC.definition: Settlement of charges in response to a prior interbank charge request.

INPC.name: InsurancePremiumCar
INPC.definition: Transaction is a payment of car insurance premium.

INPR.name: InsurancePremiumRefund
INPR.definition: Transaction is related to an insurance premium refund.

INSC.name: PaymentOfInsuranceClaim
INSC.definition: Transaction is related to the payment of an insurance claim.

INSM.name: Installment
INSM.definition: Transaction is related to a payment of an installment.

INSU.name: InsurancePremium
INSU.definition: Transaction is payment of an insurance premium.

INTC.name: IntraCompanyPayment
INTC.definition: Transaction is an intra-company payment, ie, a payment between two companies belonging to the same group.

INTP.name: IntraPartyPayment
INTP.definition: Transaction is a payment between two accounts belonging to the same party (intra-party payment), where party is a natural person (identified by a private ID, not organisation ID).

INTX.name: IncomeTax
INTX.definition: Transaction is related to a payment of income tax.

INVS.name: InvestmentAndSecurities
INVS.definition: Transaction is for the payment of mutual funds, investment products and shares

IPAY.name: InstantPayments
IPAY.definition: Transaction in which the amount is available to the payee immediately.

IPCA.name: InstantPaymentsCancellation
IPCA.definition: Transaction in which the Return of the amount is fully returned.

IPDO.name: InstantPaymentsForDonations
IPDO.definition: Transaction in which the amount is available to the payee immediately, done for donations, with sending the address data of the payer.

IPEA.name: InstantPaymentsInECommerceWithoutAddressData
IPEA.definition: Transaction in which the amount is available to the payee immediately, done in E-commerce, without sending the address data of the payer.

IPEC.name: InstantPaymentsInECommerceWithAddressData
IPEC.definition: Transaction in which the amount is available to the payee immediately, done in E-commerce, with sending the address data of the payer.

IPEW.name: InstantPaymentsInECommerce
IPEW.definition: Transaction in which the amount is available to the payee immediately, done in E-commerce.

IPPS.name: InstantPaymentsAtPOS
IPPS.definition: Transaction in which the amount is available to the payee immediately, done at POS.

IPRT.name: InstantPaymentsReturn
IPRT.definition: Transaction in which the Return of the amount is fully or partial returned.

IPU2.name: InstantPaymentsUnattendedVendingMachineWith2FA
IPU2.definition: Transaction is made via an unattending vending machine by using 2-factor-authentification.

IPUW.name: InstantPaymentsUnattendedVendingMachineWithout2FA
IPUW.definition: Transaction is made via an unattending vending machine by without using 2-factor-authentification.

IVPT.name: InvoicePayment
IVPT.definition: Transaction is the payment for invoices.

LBIN.name: LendingBuyInNetting
LBIN.definition: Net payment related to a buy-in. When an investment manager is bought in on a sell trade that fails due to a failed securities lending recall, the IM may seize the underlying collateral to pay for the buy-in. Any difference between the value of the collateral and the sell proceeds would be paid or received under this code

LBRI.name: LaborInsurance
LBRI.definition: Transaction is a payment of labor insurance.

LBXX.name: LongBoxTransfer
LBXX.definition: Transaction is related to a cash transfer from an underlying fund to a holding collateralization account (ie. Longbox) for potential further use as collateral or back to the fund in case it is not required anymore.

LCOL.name: LendingCashCollateralFreeMovement
LCOL.definition: Free movement of cash collateral. Cash collateral paid by the borrower is done separately from the delivery of the shares at loan opening or return of collateral done separately from return of the loaned security. Note: common when the currency of the security is different the currency of the cash collateral.

LFEE.name: LendingFees
LFEE.definition:
Fee payments, other than rebates, for securities lending. Includes (a) exclusive fees; (b) transaction fees; (c)
custodian fees; (d) minimum balance fees

LICF.name: LicenseFee
LICF.definition: Transaction is payment of a license fee.

LIFI.name: LifeInsurance
LIFI.definition: Transaction is a payment of life insurance.

LIMA.name: LiquidityManagement
LIMA.definition: Bank initiated account transfer to support zero target balance management, pooling or sweeping.

LMEQ.name: LendingEquityMarkedToMarketCashCollateral
LMEQ.definition: Cash collateral payments resulting from the marked-to-market of a portfolio of loaned equity securities

LMFI.name: LendingFixedIncomeMarkedToMarketCashCollateral
LMFI.definition: Cash collateral payments resulting from the marked-to-market of a portfolio of loaned fixed income securities

LMRK.name: LendingUnspecifiedTypeOfMarkedToMarketCashCollateral
LMRK.definition:
Cash collateral payments resulting from the marked-to-market of a portfolio of loaned securities where the instrument
types are not specified

LOAN.name: Loan
LOAN.definition: Transaction is related to transfer of loan to borrower.

LOAR.name: LoanRepayment
LOAR.definition: Transaction is related to repayment of loan to lender.

LOTT.name: LotteryPayment
LOTT.definition: General-Payment towards a purchase or winnings received from lottery activities.

LREV.name: LendingRevenuePayments
LREV.definition: Revenue payments made by the lending agent to the client

LSFL.name: LendingClaimPayment
LSFL.definition: Payments made by a borrower to a lending agent to satisfy claims made by the investment manager related to sell fails from late loan recall deliveries

LTCF.name: LongTermCareFacility
LTCF.definition: Transaction is a payment for long-term care facility services.

MAFC.name: MedicalAidFundContribution
MAFC.definition: Transaction is contribution to medical aid fund.

MARF.name: MedicalAidRefund
MARF.definition: Transaction is related to a medical aid refund.

MARG.name: DailyMarginOnListedDerivatives
MARG.definition: Daily margin on listed derivatives – not segregated as collateral associated with an FCM agreement. Examples include listed futures and options margin payments; premiums for listed options not covered in the MT54X message.

MBSB.name: MBSBrokerOwnedCashCollateral
MBSB.definition: MBS Broker Owned Segregated (40Act/Dodd Frank) Cash Collateral - Any cash payment related to the collateral for a Mortgage Back Security, which is segregated, and not available for use by the client.

MBSC.name: MBSClientOwnedCashCollateral
MBSC.definition: MBS Client Owned Cash Segregated (40Act/Dodd Frank) Cash Collateral - Any cash payment related to the collateral for a Mortgage Back Security, which is owned by the client and is available for use by the client when it is returned to them from the segregated account

MCDM.name: MultiCurrenyChequeDomestic
MCDM.definition: Transaction is the payment of a domestic multi-currency cheque

MCFG.name: MultiCurrenyChequeForeign
MCFG.definition: Transaction is the payment of a foreign multi-currency cheque

MDCS.name: MedicalServices
MDCS.definition: Transaction is a payment for medical care services.

MDEP.name: MicroDeposit
MDEP.definition: Transaction is a small deposit, e.g., for account verification purposes.

MFSR.name: MutualFundSubscriptionRedemption
MFSR.definition: Payment related to shares settlement of a subscription or redemption order.

MGCC.name: FuturesInitialMargin
MGCC.definition: Initial futures margin. Where such payment is owned by the client and is available for use by them on return

MGSC.name: FuturesInitialMarginClientOwnedSegregatedCashCollateral
MGSC.definition: Margin Client Owned Segregated Cash Collateral - Any cash payment related to the collateral for initial futures margin, which is owned by the client and is available for use by the client when it is returned to them from the segregated account.

MOMA.name: MoneyMarket
MOMA.definition: Securities Lending-ettlement of Money Market PCH.

MP2B.name: MobileP2BPayment
MP2B.definition: A service which enables a user to use an app on its mobile to pay a merchant or other business payees by initiating a payment message. Within this context, the account information or an alias of the payee might be transported through different channels to the app, for example QR Code, NFC, Bluetooth, other Networks.

MP2P.name: MobileP2PPayment
MP2P.definition: A service which enables a user to use an app on its mobile to initiate moving funds from his/her bank account to another person’s bank account while not using the account number  but an alias information like an MSISDN as account addressing information in his/her app.

MSVC.name: MultipleServiceTypes
MSVC.definition: Transaction is related to a payment for multiple service types.

MTUP.name: MobileTopUp
MTUP.definition: A Service that is first reserving money from a card account and then is loading a prepaid mobile phone amount by this amount.

NETT.name: Netting
NETT.definition: Transaction is related to a netting operation.

NITX.name: NetIncomeTax
NITX.definition: Transaction is related to a payment of net income tax.

NOWS.name: NotOtherwiseSpecified
NOWS.definition: Transaction is related to a payment for type of services not specified elsewhere.

NWCH.name: NetworkCharge
NWCH.definition: Transaction is related to a payment of network charges.

NWCM.name: NetworkCommunication
NWCM.definition: Transaction is related to a payment of network communication.

OCCC.name: ClientOwnedOCCPledgedCollateral
OCCC.definition: Client owned collateral identified as eligible for OCC pledging.

OCDM.name: OrderChequeDomestic
OCDM.definition: Transaction is the payment of a domestic order cheque

OCFG.name: OrderChequeForeign
OCFG.definition: Transaction is the payment of a foreign order cheque

ODPY.name: OnDemandPayment
ODPY.definition: On demand/Real-time payments, e.g., Same-day wage access, gig economy payouts.

OFEE.name: OpeningFee
OFEE.definition: Transaction is related to a payment of opening fee.

OPBC.name: OTCOptionBrokerOwnedCashCollateral
OPBC.definition: Cash collateral payment for OTC options associated with an FCM agreement. Where such payment is segregated and not available for use by the client

OPCC.name: OTCOptionClientOwnedCashCollateral
OPCC.definition: Cash collateral payment for OTC options associated with an FCM agreement. Where such payment is not segregated and is available for use by the client upon return

OPSB.name: OTCOptionBrokerOwnedSegregatedCashCollateral
OPSB.definition: Option Broker Owned Segregated Cash Collateral - Any cash payment related to the collateral for an OTC option, which is segregated, and not available for use by the client.

OPSC.name: OTCOptionClientOwnedCashSegregatedCashCollateral
OPSC.definition: Option Client Owned Cash Segregated Cash Collateral - Any cash payment related to the collateral for an OTC option, which is owned by the client and is available for use by the client when it is returned to them from the segregated account

OPTN.name: FXOption
OPTN.definition: Cash collateral related to trading of option on Foreign Exchange.

OTCD.name: OTCDerivatives
OTCD.definition: Cash collateral related to Over-the-counter (OTC) Derivatives in general for example contracts which are traded and privately negotiated.

OTLC.name: OtherTelecomRelatedBill
OTLC.definition: Transaction is related to a payment of other telecom related bill.

PADD.name: PreauthorizedDebit
PADD.definition: Transaction is related to a pre-authorized debit origination

PAYR.name: Payroll
PAYR.definition: Transaction is related to the payment of payroll.

PCOM.name: PropertyCompletionPayment
PCOM.definition: Final payment to complete the purchase of a property.

PDEP.name: PropertyDeposit
PDEP.definition: Payment of the deposit required towards purchase of a property.

PDLN.name: PayDayLoan
PDLN.definition: Pay Day Loan, e.g., short-term, high-interest loans typically due on borrower's next payday.

PEFC.name: PensionFundContribution
PEFC.definition: Transaction is contribution to pension fund.

PENO.name: PaymentBasedOnEnforcementOrder
PENO.definition: Payment based on enforcement orders except those arising from judicial alimony decrees.

PENS.name: PensionPayment
PENS.definition: Transaction is the payment of pension.

PHON.name: TelephoneBill
PHON.definition: Transaction is related to a payment of telephone bill.

PLDS.name: PropertyLoanDisbursement
PLDS.definition: Payment of funds from a lender as part of the issuance of a property loan.

PLRF.name: PropertyLoanRefinancing

POPE.name: PointOfPurchaseEntry
POPE.definition: Transaction is related to a payment associated with a Point of Purchase Entry.

PPTI.name: PropertyInsurance

PTXP.name: PropertyTax
PTXP.definition: Transaction is related to a payment of property tax.

RAPI.name: RapidPaymentInstruction

RCKE.name: RepresentedCheckEntry
RCKE.definition: Transaction is related to a payment associated with a re-presented check entry

RCPT.name: ReceiptPayment
RCPT.definition: Transaction is related to a payment of receipt.

RDTX.name: RoadTax
RDTX.definition: Transaction is related to a payment of road tax.

REBT.name: Rebate
REBT.definition: Transaction is the payment of a rebate.

REFU.name: Refund

RETL.name: RetailPayment

RHBS.name: RehabilitationSupport

RHSV.name: RideHailingServices
RHSV.definition: Ride-hailing/Delivery Service, e.g., payments for app-based rides.

RIMB.name: ReimbursementOfAPreviousErroneousTransaction
RIMB.definition: Transaction is related to a reimbursement of a previous erroneous transaction.

RINP.name: RecurringInstallmentPayment
RINP.definition: Transaction is related to a payment of a recurring installment made at regular intervals.

RLWY.name: Railway
RLWY.definition: Transaction is a payment for railway transport related business.

ROYA.name: Royalties
ROYA.definition: Transaction is the payment of royalties.

RPBC.name: BilateralRepoBrokerOwnedCollateral
RPBC.definition: Bi-lateral repo broker owned collateral associated with a repo master agreement – GMRA or MRA Master Repo Agreements.

RPCC.name: RepoClientOwnedCollateral
RPCC.definition: Repo client owned collateral associated with a repo master agreement – GMRA or MRA Master Repo Agreements

RPNT.name: BilateralRepoInternetNetting
RPNT.definition: Bi-lateral repo interest net/bulk payment at rollover/pair-off or other closing scenarios where applicable.

RPSB.name: BilateralRepoBrokerOwnedSegregatedCashCollateral
RPSB.definition: Bi-lateral repo broker owned segregated cash collateral associated with a repo master agreement.

RPSC.name: BilateralRepoClientOwnedSegregatedCashCollateral
RPSC.definition: Repo client owned segregated collateral associated with a repo master agreement.

RRBN.name: RoundRobin
RRBN.definition: Cash payment resulting from a Round Robin

RRCT.name: ReimbursementReceivedCreditTransfer
RRCT.definition: Transaction is related to a reimbursement for commercial reasons of a correctly received credit transfer.

RRTP.name: RelatedRequestToPay
RRTP.definition: Transaction is related to a Request to Pay.

RVPM.name: ReceiveAgainstPayment
RVPM.definition: Code used to pre-advise the account servicer of a forthcoming receive against payment instruction.

RVPO.name: ReverseRepurchaseAgreement
RVPO.definition: Cash collateral related to a reverse repurchase agreement transaction.

SALA.name: SalaryPayment
SALA.definition: Transaction is the payment of salaries.

SAVG.name: Savings
SAVG.definition: Transfer to / from savings or to retirement account.

SBSC.name: SecuritiesBuySellSellBuyBack
SBSC.definition: Cash collateral related to a Securities Buy Sell Sell Buy Back

SCAC.name: SchoolActivities
SCAC.definition: Transaction is related to payment for school activities, extracurricular programs.

SCIE.name: SingleCurrencyIRSExotic
SCIE.definition: Cash collateral related to Exotic single currency interest rate swap.

SCIR.name: SingleCurrencyIRS
SCIR.definition: Cash collateral related to Single Currency Interest Rate Swap.

SCRP.name: SecuritiesCrossProducts
SCRP.definition: Cash collateral related to Combination of securities-related exposure types.

SCVE.name: PurchaseSaleOfServices
SCVE.definition: Transaction is related to purchase and sale of services.

SECU.name: Securities
SECU.definition: Transaction is the payment of securities.

SEPI.name: SecuritiesPurchaseInhouse
SEPI.definition: Transaction is the payment of a purchase of securities where custodian bank and current account servicing bank coincide

SERV.name: ServiceCharges
SERV.definition: Transaction is related to service charges charged by a service provider.

SHBC.name: BrokerOwnedCollateralShortSale
SHBC.definition: Short Sale broker owned collateral associated with a prime broker agreement.

SHCC.name: ClientOwnedCollateralShortSale
SHCC.definition: Short Sale client owned collateral associated with a prime brokerage agreement.

SHSL.name: ShortSell
SHSL.definition: Cash Collateral related to a Short Sell

SLDS.name: StudentLoanDisbursement
SLDS.definition: Student Loan Disbursement, e.g., disbursing tuition funds to educational institutions or directly to students.

SLEB.name: SecuritiesLendingAndBorrowing
SLEB.definition: Cash collateral related to Securities lending and borrowing.

SLOA.name: SecuredLoan
SLOA.definition: Cash collateral related to a Secured loan.

SLPI.name: PaymentSlipInstruction
SLPI.definition: Transaction is payment of a well formatted payment slip.

SPLT.name: SplitPayments
SPLT.definition:
Split payments. To be used when cash and security movements for a security trade settlement are instructed
separately.

SPSP.name: SalaryPensionSumPayment
SPSP.definition: Salary or pension payment for more months in one amount or a delayed payment of salaries or pensions.

SSBE.name: SocialSecurityBenefit
SSBE.definition: Transaction is a social security benefit, ie payment made by a government to support individuals.

STDY.name: Study
STDY.definition: Transaction is related to a payment of study/tuition costs.

STRM.name: StreamingServices
STRM.definition: Streaming Services, e.g., monthly subscriptions to digital content platforms.

SUBS.name: Subscription
SUBS.definition: Transaction is related to a payment of information or entertainment services either in printed or electronic form.

SUPP.name: SupplierPayment
SUPP.definition: Transaction is related to a payment to a supplier.

SWBC.name: SwapBrokerOwnedCashCollateral
SWBC.definition:
Cash collateral payment for swaps associated with an ISDA agreement. . Where such payment is segregated and
not available for use by the client. Includes any cash collateral payments made under the terms of a CSA agreement
for instruments such as swaps and FX forwards.

SWCC.name: SwapClientOwnedCashCollateral
SWCC.definition:
Cash collateral payment for swaps associated with an ISDA agreement. Where such payment is not segregated and
is available for use by the client upon return. Includes any cash collateral payments made under the terms of a CSA
agreement for instruments such as swaps and FX forwards.

SWFP.name: SwapContractFinalPayment
SWFP.definition: Final payments for a swap contract

SWPP.name: SwapContractPartialPayment
SWPP.definition: Partial payment for a swap contract

SWPT.name: Swaption
SWPT.definition: Cash collateral related to an option on interest rate swap.

SWRS.name: SwapContractResetPayment
SWRS.definition: Reset payment for a swap contract

SWSB.name: SwapsBrokerOwnedSegregatedCashCollateral
SWSB.definition:
Swaps Broker Owned Segregated Cash Collateral - Any cash payment related to the collateral for Swap margin ,
which is segregated, and not available for use by the client. This includes any collateral identified in a CSA
agreement such as Swap or FX Forward collateral.

SWSC.name: SwapsClientOwnedSegregatedCashCollateral
SWSC.definition:
Swaps Client Owned Segregated Cash Collateral - Any cash payment related to the collateral for Swap margin,
which is owned by the client and is available for use by the client when returned from the segregated account. This
includes any collateral identified in a CSA agreement such as Swap or FX Forward collateral.

SWUF.name: SwapContractUpfrontPayment
SWUF.definition: Upfront payment for a swap contract

TAXR.name: TaxRefund
TAXR.definition: Transaction is the refund of a tax payment or obligation.

TAXS.name: TaxPayment
TAXS.definition: Transaction is the payment of taxes.

TBAN.name: TBAPairOffNetting
TBAN.definition: TBA pair-off cash wire net movement

TBAS.name: ToBeAnnounced
TBAS.definition: Cash collateral related to a To Be Announced (TBA)

TBBC.name: TBABrokerOwnedCashCollateral
TBBC.definition: Cash collateral payment (segregated) for TBA securities associated with a TBA Master Agreement. Where such payment is segregated and not available for use by the client.

TBCC.name: TBAClientOwnedCashCollateral
TBCC.definition: Cash collateral payment (for use by client)for TBA securities associated with a TBA Master Agreement. Where such payment is not segregated and is available for use by the client upon return.

TBIL.name: TelecommunicationsBill
TBIL.definition: Transaction is related to a payment of telecommunications related bill.

TCSC.name: TownCouncilServiceCharges
TCSC.definition: Transaction is related to a payment associated with charges levied by a town council.

TELI.name: TelephoneInitiatedTransaction
TELI.definition: Transaction is related to a payment initiated via telephone.

TIPS.name: TipsGratuity
TIPS.definition: Tip/Gratuity, e.g., additional payments for service workers at restaurants, hotels, salons, or through digital tipping platforms.

TLRF.name: NonUSMutualFundTrailerFeePayment
TLRF.definition: Any non-US mutual fund trailer fee (retrocession) payment (use ISIN to determine onshore versus offshore designation)

TLRR.name: NonUSMutualFundTrailerFeeRebatePayment
TLRR.definition: Any non-US mutual fund trailer fee (retrocession) rebate payment (use ISIN to determine onshore versus offshore designation)

TMPG.name: TMPGClaimPayment
TMPG.definition: Cash payment resulting from a TMPG Claim

TNTP.name: TaxNeutralPensionTransfer
TNTP.definition: Transaction is a tax-neutral transfer of existing pension balance.

TOLL.name: Tolls
TOLL.definition: Tolls, e.g., payments for road tolls, bridges, tunnels, or electronic toll collection systems.

TPRP.name: TriPartyRepoNetting
TPRP.definition: Tri-party Repo related net gain/loss cash movement

TRAD.name: Commercial
TRAD.definition: Transaction is related to a trade services operation.

TRCP.name: TreasuryCrossProduct
TRCP.definition: Cash collateral related to a combination of treasury-related exposure types.

TREA.name: TreasuryPayment
TREA.definition: Transaction is related to treasury operations.

TRFD.name: TrustFund
TRFD.definition: Transaction is related to a payment of a trust fund.

TRNC.name: TruncatedPaymentSlip
TRNC.definition: Transaction is payment of a beneficiary prefilled payment slip where beneficiary to payer information is truncated.

TRPT.name: RoadPricing
TRPT.definition: Transaction is for the payment to top-up pre-paid card and electronic road pricing for the purpose of transportation

TRVC.name: TravellerCheque
TRVC.definition: Transaction is the payment of a travellers cheque

TRVL.name: TravelAndHospitality
TRVL.definition: Generic code for travel and hospitality related transactions, e.g., hotel bookings, vacation rentals, travel packages, or direct hotel reservations.

UBIL.name: Utilities
UBIL.definition: Transaction is for the payment to common utility provider that provide gas, water and/or electricity.

UNIT.name: UnitTrustPurchase
UNIT.definition: Transaction is purchase of Unit Trust

VATX.name: ValueAddedTaxPayment
VATX.definition: Transaction is the payment of value added tax.

VIEW.name: VisionCare
VIEW.definition: Transaction is a payment for vision care services.

WALM.name: WalletFundingMultiUse
WALM.definition: Account transfer funding a multi-use wallet.

WALS.name: WalletFundingSingle
WALS.definition: Account transfer funding a single purpose wallet.

WALT.name: WalletTransactions
WALT.definition: Transaction is related to digital wallet funding or defunding.

WEBI.name: InternetInitiatedTransaction
WEBI.definition: Transaction is related to a payment initiated via internet.

WHLD.name: WithHolding
WHLD.definition: Transaction is related to a payment of withholding tax.

WTER.name: WaterBill
WTER.definition: Transaction is related to a payment of water bill.

ExternalRegulatoryReportingType1Code.definition:
Specifies the type of regulatory reporting, as published in an external code set.
External code sets can be downloaded from www.iso20022.org.

CIST.name: CitizenshipStatus
CIST.definition: Regulatory Authority requires the status of residency of an involved party, e.g. if it is a resident or non-resident. This type code may refer to information in any element under the same occurrence of “RgltryRptg/Dtls”.

CRST.name: CreditorStatus
CRST.definition: Regulatory Authority requires the status or type of Creditor, e.g. if it is a corporation, an individual or the government. This type code may refer to information in any element under the same occurrence of “RgltryRptg/Dtls”.

DECL.name: Declaration
DECL.definition: The transaction includes a declaration confirming compliance with applicable regulatory and sanctions requirements (e.g., FEFTA, OFAC, or other relevant frameworks). This type code refers to information in any element under the same occurrence of “RgltryRptg/Dtls”.

PURP.name: NewCode
PURP.definition: Regulatory Authority requires or recommends a code or narrative text to identify the purpose of payment in line with the specific requirements of that authority. This type code may refer to information in any element under the same occurrence of “RgltryRptg/Dtls”.

TAXS.name: TaxStatus
TAXS.definition: Regulatory Authority requires a tax information, e.g. an tax identification reference. This type code may refer to information in any element under the same occurrence of “RgltryRptg/Dtls”.

ExternalServiceLevel1Code.definition:
Specifies the external service level code in the format of character string with a maximum length of 4 characters.
The list of valid codes is an external code list published separately.
External code sets can be downloaded from www.iso20022.org.

EAPS.name: EastAfricanPaymentSystem
EAPS.definition: Identifies payments executed under the East African Payment System (EAPS), the regional cross-border settlement scheme operated by EAC central banks.

EOLO.name: EuroOneLegOut
EOLO.definition: Payment is executed following a Euro One-Leg Out Scheme.

G006.name: TrackedCaseManagement
G006.definition: Specifies the service conditions applicable to a tracked exceptions and investigations case.

G007.name: TrackedInboundCustomerCreditTransfer
G007.definition: Specifies the service level for a tracked inbound customer credit transfer.

G009.name: TrackedLowValueCrossBorderCustomerCreditTransfer
G009.definition: Specifies the service level for a tracked low-value cross-border customer credit transfer.

INST.name: InstantCreditTransferOrInstantDirectDebit
INST.definition: Used for payment initiation to identify that a Payment or Direct Debit initiation must be executed as an instant or real-time payment instrument.

IRCA.name: IcelandicRulebookCouncilArea
IRCA.definition: Payment must be executed following the Icelandic Rulebook Council Area (IRCA) scheme.

NOLO.name: NPCOneLegOut
NOLO.definition: Payment is executed following the NPC One-Leg Out Scheme.

NPCA.name: NordicPaymentsCouncilAreaTransfer
NPCA.definition: Payments must be executed following the NPC Area Payment scheme.

NUGP.name: NonurgentPriorityPayment
NUGP.definition: Payment must be executed as a non-urgent transaction with priority settlement.

NURG.name: NonurgentPayment
NURG.definition: Payment must be executed as a non-urgent transaction, which is typically identified as an ACH or low value transaction.

PRPT.name: EBAPriorityService
PRPT.definition: Transaction must be processed according to the EBA Priority Service.

SD01.name: SwiftDigitalServiceSwiftLedger
SD01.definition: Digital asset transactions must be processed according to the Swift Ledger rules.

SDVA.name: SameDayValue
SDVA.definition: Payment must be executed with same day value to the creditor.

SEPA.name: SingleEuroPaymentsArea
SEPA.definition: Payment must be executed following the Single Euro Payments Area scheme.

SPLI.name: SplitPayment
SPLI.definition: A split payment is a payment that is split into several payments of lower value, namely with the purpose to comply with maximum amount thresholds applicable to some domestic Payment Market Infrastructures or to reduce counterparty liquidity risk.

SPSC.name: SwiftScheme
SPSC.definition: Transaction must be processed according to the Swift Scheme rulebook.

SRTP.name: ServiceRequestToPay
SRTP.definition: Request to Pay (RTP) transaction refers to an RTP scheme (such as for example the SEPA Request to Pay (SRTP) scheme).

SVDE.name: DomesticChequeClearingAndSettlement
SVDE.definition: Payment execution following the cheque agreement and traveller cheque agreement of the German Banking Industry Committee (Die Deutsche Kreditwirtschaft - DK) and Deutsche Bundesbank – Scheck Verrechnung Deutschland

URGP.name: UrgentPayment
URGP.definition: Payment must be executed as an urgent transaction cleared through a real-time gross settlement system, which is typically identified as a wire or high value transaction.

URNS.name: UrgentPaymentNetSettlement
URNS.definition: Payment must be executed as an urgent transaction cleared through a real-time net settlement system, which is typically identified as a wire or high value transaction.

WFSM.name: WaitForSettlement
WFSM.definition: Transaction is to be treated as an advice and only applied to the account of the creditor or next agent after settlement of the cover has been confirmed.

Frequency6Code.definition: Specifies the regularity of an event.

ADHO.name: Adhoc
ADHO.definition: Event takes place on request or as necessary.

FRTN.name: Fortnightly
FRTN.definition: Event takes place every two weeks.

INDA.name: IntraDay
INDA.definition: Event takes place several times a day.

MIAN.name: SemiAnnual
MIAN.definition: Event takes place every six months or two times a year.

MNTH.name: Monthly
MNTH.definition: Event takes place every month or once a month.

QURT.name: Quarterly
QURT.definition: Event takes place every three months or four times a year.

WEEK.name: Weekly
WEEK.definition: Event takes place once a week.

YEAR.name: Annual
YEAR.definition: Event takes place every year or once a year.

Instruction4Code.definition: Specifies further instructions concerning the processing of a payment instruction, provided by the sending clearing agent to the next agent(s).

PHOA.name: PhoneNextAgent
PHOA.definition: Please advise/contact next agent by phone.

TELA.name: TelecomNextAgent
TELA.definition: Please advise/contact next agent by the most efficient means of telecommunication.

MandateClassification1Code.definition: Specifies the type of direct debit amount, such as fixed or variable.

USGB.name: UsageBased
USGB.definition: Direct debit amount is based on usage.

NamePrefix2Code.definition: Specifies the terms used to formally address a person.

DOCT.name: Doctor
DOCT.definition: Title of the person is Doctor or Dr.

MADM.name: Madam
MADM.definition: Title of the person is Madam.

MIKS.name: GenderNeutral
MIKS.definition: Title of the person is gender neutral (Mx).

MISS.name: Miss
MISS.definition: Title of the person is Miss.

MIST.name: Mister
MIST.definition: Title of the person is Mister or Mr.

PreferredContactMethod2Code.definition: Preferred method used to reach the individual contact within an organisation.

CELL.name: MobileOrCellPhone
CELL.definition: Preferred method used to reach the contact is per mobile or cell phone.

FAXX.name: Fax
FAXX.definition: Preferred method used to reach the contact is per fax.

LETT.name: Letter
LETT.definition: Preferred method used to reach the contact is per letter.

MAIL.name: Email
MAIL.definition: Preferred method used to reach the contact is per email.

ONLI.name: Online
ONLI.definition: Preferred method used to reach the contact is online.

PHON.name: Phone
PHON.definition: Preferred method used to reach the contact is per phone.

Priority2Code.definition: Specifies the priority level of an event.

Priority3Code.definition: Specifies the priority level of an event.

URGT.name: Urgent
URGT.definition: Priority level is urgent (highest priority possible).

RegulatoryReportingType1Code.definition: Identifies whether the regulatory reporting information applies to the debit side, to the credit side or to both debit and credit sides of the transaction.

BOTH.name: Both
BOTH.definition: Regulatory information applies to both credit and debit sides.

CRED.name: Credit
CRED.definition: Regulatory information applies to the credit side.

DEBT.name: Debit
DEBT.definition: Regulatory information applies to the debit side.

RemittanceLocationMethod2Code.definition: Specifies the method used to deliver the remittance advice information.

EDIC.name: ElectronicDataInterchange
EDIC.definition: Remittance advice information must be sent through Electronic Data Interchange (EDI).

EMAL.name: EMail
EMAL.definition: Remittance advice information must be sent through e-mail.

FAXI.name: Fax
FAXI.definition: Remittance advice information must be faxed.

POST.name: Post
POST.definition: Remittance advice information must be sent through postal services.

SMSM.name: SMS
SMSM.definition: Remittance advice information must be sent through by phone as a short message service (SMS).

URID.name: UniformResourceIdentifier
URID.definition: Remittance advice information needs to be sent to a Uniform Resource Identifier (URI). URI is a compact string of characters that uniquely identify an abstract or physical resource. URI's are the super-set of identifiers, such as URLs, email addresses, ftp sites, etc, and as such, provide the syntax for all of the identification schemes.

SettlementMethod1Code.definition: Specifies the method used to settle the credit transfer instruction.

CLRG.name: ClearingSystem
CLRG.definition: Settlement is done through a payment clearing system.

COVE.name: CoverMethod
COVE.definition: Settlement is done through a cover payment.

INDA.name: InstructedAgent
INDA.definition: Settlement is done by the agent instructed to execute a payment instruction.

INGA.name: InstructingAgent
INGA.definition: Settlement is done by the agent instructing and forwarding the payment to the next party in the payment chain.

TaxRecordPeriod1Code.definition: Specifies the period related to the tax payment.

HLF1.name: FirstHalf
HLF1.definition: Tax is related to the first half of the period.

HLF2.name: SecondHalf
HLF2.definition: Tax is related to the second half of the period.

MM01.name: FirstMonth
MM01.definition: Tax is related to the second month of the period.

MM02.name: SecondMonth
MM02.definition: Tax is related to the first month of the period.

MM03.name: ThirdMonth
MM03.definition: Tax is related to the third month of the period.

MM04.name: FourthMonth
MM04.definition: Tax is related to the fourth month of the period.

MM05.name: FifthMonth
MM05.definition: Tax is related to the fifth month of the period.

MM06.name: SixthMonth
MM06.definition: Tax is related to the sixth month of the period.

MM07.name: SeventhMonth
MM07.definition: Tax is related to the seventh month of the period.

MM08.name: EighthMonth
MM08.definition: Tax is related to the eighth month of the period.

MM09.name: NinthMonth
MM09.definition: Tax is related to the ninth month of the period.

MM10.name: TenthMonth
MM10.definition: Tax is related to the tenth month of the period.

MM11.name: EleventhMonth
MM11.definition: Tax is related to the eleventh month of the period.

MM12.name: TwelfthMonth
MM12.definition: Tax is related to the twelfth month of the period.

QTR1.name: FirstQuarter
QTR1.definition: Tax is related to the first quarter of the period.

QTR2.name: SecondQuarter
QTR2.definition: Tax is related to the second quarter of the period.

QTR3.name: ThirdQuarter
QTR3.definition: Tax is related to the third quarter of the period.

QTR4.name: FourthQuarter
QTR4.definition: Tax is related to the forth quarter of the period.
